_doc: Applied by tools/import-datadog.mjs to imported columns/symbols by OID: semantics the MIB alone cannot express. Keys are column/scalar OIDs; values are merged into the nf-snmp symbol.

1.3.6.1.2.1.99.1.1.1.4._why: RFC 3433 entPhySensorValue must be decoded with entPhySensorScale/Precision/OperStatus; Datadog reads it raw (255 instead of 25.5 degC).
